title: Treating nail fungus
what: Nail fungus makes nails thick, yellow and brittle. Treatment is long: ointments, lacquers, pills and nail cleaning by a doctor.
why: When your nails have changed and the doctor has confirmed fungus with a test.
duration: nail cleaning usually takes 20 to 40 minutes; treatment usually takes months, until a healthy nail grows out
tell_doctor: All your medicines - antifungal pills do not mix with all of them
Liver disease, diabetes, poor blood flow in the legs
How many nails are affected and for how long

prepare.title: Test
prepare.text: Before treatment a nail scraping is usually taken to confirm the fungus.

prepare.title: Feet
prepare.text: On the day of cleaning wash your feet and take the polish off your nails.

prepare.title: Blood tests
prepare.text: Before pills the liver is sometimes checked - your doctor will say.

bring: Your referral and the test result
steps: Your feet are treated with antiseptic
The affected part of the nail is carefully filed away with a device or instrument
The nail becomes thinner - medicine gets in better
The doctor explains the home treatment plan
feel: Cleaning is usually painless, with light vibration or warmth
If the nail is very thick it can be unpleasant
after: Apply the product every day as your doctor prescribed - skipping slows down treatment
Treat your shoes and wear clean socks
Do not walk barefoot at the pool and bath house
Do not stop when the nail seems better - finish the course
red_flags: Redness, swelling, pain and pus around the nail - see a doctor
Yellow skin, dark urine or nausea while taking pills - see a doctor right away

faq.a: A nail grows slowly. Treatment ends when a healthy nail has fully grown out.
Yes. To prevent it, treat your shoes and do not walk barefoot in shared places.

reminders.text: Nail cleaning tomorrow. Wash your feet and take the polish off.
